nodes.name: VerifyAppleRequest
nodes.role: confirm that the call really came from Apple by checking the claim through Apple's official support channels, not the number that called

nodes.name: ReviewPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the amount the user paid for the iPhone from the purchase record the user names

nodes.name: ComputeVatDifference
nodes.role: calculate the additional 19.5% VAT on the amount paid, add the 5.29 fee, and produce the total with its breakdown

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the verification result and the computed total, and ask for explicit approval before any payment

nodes.name: SendPaymentToApple
nodes.role: pay the approved total to Apple only if the user has approved it
